### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c88467d4adc417e668474e1b6198a5a7c503ac3f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `061f69c580626603cdcd94e10d649049a270bdc5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts + packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts, packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts, packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts, packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts, scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs

Inputs read: card #29335 (body, triage 6577799350, claim 6582652162, dev report 6583541780), PR #29514 (body, 2 files, net diff against `main` at the head), the 41 check-runs on the head. The head's merge-base with `main` is `86d36e99`; no `main` commit since touches `stack.zod.ts`, and the three-dot diff is the two files alone.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — right.** The only code line in the hunk's neighbourhood, `TOP_LEVEL_COLLECTIONS_NEVER_RESIDUAL = new Set(['data', 'datasets', 'jobs'])` (L373 on `main`), is not touched; neither are `isResidualTopLevelItem`, `residualSlotOf` or `applyCollectionItemOwnerStampGate`. `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` accepts and refuses exactly what it did.
- **Public surface: unchanged — right.** The constant is module-private (no `export`), so no `index.d.ts`, json-schema, liveness ledger or api-surface line moves; `Spec property liveness` concluded `success` and no regenerated artifact was owed.
- **Each claim the new comment makes, read in the cited code — right:**
  - `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` L130-175) has no `data`, `datasets` or `jobs` row, and `unclaimedTopLevel` (L415-424) walks exactly that map, so no top-level item of the three is ever listed as residual.
  - Seed `data`: `AppPlugin` reads `this.collections.data` (`app-plugin.ts` L1720-1745), where `collections` is `resolveArtifactCollections(this.bundle)` (L307); that resolver (`artifact-collections.ts` L457-490) merges the top-level value with every body's over `packageOwnedCollectionKeys()`, the keys shared by `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` and `AssembledPackageBodySchema`, and `data`, `jobs`, `datasets` are all `concat` body collections (`stack.zod.ts` L1617-1641). "Read off the stack whole, the top level merged with every body" is exact.
  - `jobs`: `collectBundleJobs` reads `resolveArtifactCollections(bundle).jobs` (L2681) and `AppPlugin` arms `scheduleAppArtifactJobs` on `kernel:ready` (L1675-1705). "Schedules the jobs" is exact.
  - `datasets`: `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` holds `'datasets'` (`engine.ts` L4444); `registerApp` runs `packageBodyCollectionRefusal` (L9295) and then `registerMetadataCollections` (L9481, loop L9594) over that list. The `manifest` service hands `registerApp` the ordered package bodies only (`objectql/src/plugin.ts` L84-85, L945) and takes the residual through `unclaimedTopLevelObjects` / `unclaimedTopLevelItems`, both `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE`-walked. "Read off the package BODIES only, by the engine's `registerApp`" is exact.
  - "No boot reader takes a top-level `datasets` item that no body declares": `app-plugin.ts` reads no `datasets` collection (every `datasets` word there is the seed-`data` collector, L80, L1720-2102, `seed-datasets.ts`); a grep of `packages/{runtime,metadata,objectql,kernel,server}/src` finds no other reader. The resolver does merge a top-level `datasets` item into `collections.datasets`, but nothing reads that key, so the sentence holds.
  - "A package BODY's items of these collections are still judged, at both doors" (kept from the old text): build door `judgeBody` over `OWNER_STAMP_JUDGED_COLLECTIONS` per body (`stack.zod.ts` L329-357); boot door `packageBodyCollectionRefusal` over `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` (`engine.ts` L5060). Still right.
- **What the old text got wrong is gone — right.** "`datasets` consumed by `AppPlugin` straight off the bundle" named a reader that does not exist on the tree; the card's one in-scope finding.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/29335-residual-datasets-docblock.md`: `@objectstack/spec: patch` — **right.** `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the comment publishes in the tarball even though `dist/` carries none of it; AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 reserves `skip-changeset` for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package, and `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`.
- `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and in the changeset, no arm; `Metadata-protocol: none` on both — **right**: no schema, type, export or authorable key moves. `Check Changeset` concluded `success`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions: []` — none to answer.
- Dev flag 1 (boot-side silent drop of a `packages[]` top-level `datasets` item no body declares): measured on a kernel boot and handed to the seat to file as `domain:server`, which is exactly what triage 6577799350 ruled ("not this card's"). The card's second *Done when* bullet is therefore deliberately open on this PR by that ruling; the `Fixes #29335` close is consistent with it. **Escalated to the seat — right.**
- Dev flag 2 (`scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` L664-667, the `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` waiver row, says `datasets` is "consumed functionally by AppPlugin straight off the bundle"): confirmed on `main`; it is the last restatement of the wrong attribution outside this PR. Outside the claimed file surface, reported not edited. **Escalated to the seat — right**; see ④ for a sibling.
- Human Minimum item 3 unchecked (`pnpm lint` not run locally): CI's Lint family owns it and was `in_progress` at read time; comment-only diff, no formatter ran.
- Docs Drift Check: no anchor for `stack.zod.ts`; nothing in `content/docs/` documents a module-private constant's comment. No action.
- Check-runs on the head at read time: 41 total; every concluded run is `success` (Auto Label, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, filter, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Flag docs affected, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard) or `skipped` (opt-in and path-gated jobs); 18 still `in_progress` (Test Core 1-8, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Live E2E UI, the Lint and Type Check families). No gate has concluded against the head; the verdict below is judged on the concluded set and on a diff that changes no tested behaviour.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (the one `hits` file), judged against the scenario the card accepts it on — a comment that names the readers the tree has — and against every file it cites:

- **Holds.** Every reader the new comment names exists where it says, does what it says, and reads the shape it says (①). The sentence structure also now explains *why* the three are grouped although their readers differ (none is an `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` item), which the old text blurred. The comment's pointer to the `@objectstack/metadata` equality test stays true: `owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts` L160-178 still asserts the not-residual set equals `['data', 'datasets', 'jobs']`.
- Tried to break it: (a) `collectBundleJobs` is one-list-or-the-other against legacy `manifest.jobs`, not a merge — but the comment's "merged" is the top-level/body merge in `resolveArtifactCollections`, which is what it cites; not a defect. (b) A body's `data` has a second boot reader (`registerApp` step 6 registers seed data as metadata); the comment lists the reader that makes `data` never-residual and claims no exclusivity; not a defect. (c) The resolver does place a top-level `datasets` item into the merged `collections.datasets`; the comment says no *reader* takes it, and none does; not a defect.
- **Should-fix (outside `hits`, carried to the seat, not blocking):** `packages/metadata/src/owner-stamp-residual-build-boot.test.ts` L173-175, the comment on the `notResidual` assertion ("the three collections the boot reads off the stack whole, never as items"), restates the reading this PR just retired for `datasets`: the engine registers a body's `datasets` *as items*, and the top level is read by nobody. The assertion is right; only its gloss is stale, and this is the very test the new docblock points readers to. Folds into the same prose follow-up as the `check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` waiver row (③ flag 2). No must-fix found.

Remainder of the diff (the changeset file): the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; judged here only as ②'s declaration, which is right.

**VERDICT: PASS**
